name: 3D Mouse Pad
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality smooth fabric, soft silicone gel, and a non-slip PU base, offering comfort, stability, and long-lasting daily use.
    - The surface features a smooth easy-glide texture, helping the mouse move accurately and comfortably.
    - Built with a soft silicone gel wrist support that provides cushioned hand placement and helps reduce pressure during extended use.
    - The non-slip PU base helps keep the mouse pad securely in place on desks and tabletops.
    - Designed to maintain its shape well, even when folded or squeezed during handling and storage.
    - Combines ergonomic comfort, playful design, and functional desk performance in one compact accessory.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall size: 21 x 25 cm ~ 8.27 x 9.84 in
    - Height: 2.32 cm ~ 0.91 in
    📌 Note:  The shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customize the printed design only.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses high-quality sublimation printing technology for sharp details, vivid colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Designed with single-sided printing on the front surface.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a mouse pad and an ergonomic wrist support accessory.
    - Suitable for office work, home desks, gaming setups, studying, browsing, and daily computer use.
    - Helps support the wrist during long periods of mouse use for improved comfort.
    - Great for desks, workstations, home offices, gaming rooms, and study tables.
    - Combines practical performance with a playful and personalized visual style.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A fun and useful gift for friends, coworkers, gamers, students, partners, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for birthdays, holidays, office gifts, gag gifts, desk upgrades, and special occasions.
    - Ideal for anyone who enjoys novelty desk accessories, custom mouse pads, or humorous personalized items.
    - Great for home offices, gaming setups, and personal workspaces.
    - A creative gift choice that combines comfort, personality, and everyday function 🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7-15 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x  3D Mouse Pad

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
